hypothesis: Additional premium relief fails to restore insured loss exposure
evidence_status: Observed CPI level; behavioral effect assumed
model_inputs: premium_assumptions.premium, reference_premium, income, vehicle_value, deductible; coverage/filing slopes
mechanism: Premium-to-income/value log burden -> lagged bounded coverage/filing probabilities
population: US insurance baseline-compatible claims, uniform affected fraction
audit_assumption: No additional relief index100 versus assumed recovery95; current saved reference already100
missing_evidence: Matched coverage exposure, renewal premiums, income/value and filing outcomes; route recapture
countercase: Actual premium cuts, income growth or payment relief improve coverage
double_count_guard: Do not reapply historical CPI increase or existing age/claims suppression

hypothesis: Lien payoff may reduce collision/comprehensive retention
mechanism: Surviving payoff -> excess cancellation -> loss-risk exposure -> net insurer/alternate routes
population: Must convert accounts to surviving covered vehicles and prospective total-loss weights
audit_assumption: Zero in integrated case; prior payoff sensitivity remains separate
outputs: premium_diagnostics and insured units only if assumptions supplied
missing_evidence: Vintage-by-term survivor schedule and coverage at payoff/renewal
countercase: Payoff releases cash; replacements may be newly financed; third-party recapture
double_count_guard: Do not stack old loan-payoff unit haircut on premium adapter

hypothesis: Rising reported TLF overstates salvage-volume recovery
evidence_status: CCC observations plus derived decomposition; response shape calibrated
model_inputs: cohort_anchor_path, cohort claim weights, nonfiling or repairable_filing
mechanism: Total-loss counts / reported claims; symmetric historical mix/within decomposition
population: CCC age/body sample with unresolved geography/coverage; 7+ broad bucket
audit_assumption: 2020-25 composition40.6% of increase; no added future TLF trend
missing_evidence: Same-population detailed-age rates and all-disposition threshold distribution
countercase: Within-group TLF grew and can grow further
double_count_guard: No independent TLF growth multiplier after damage selection

hypothesis: Repair and expected recovery tailwinds may be smaller than extrapolated
mechanism: Repair versus value less expected net salvage -> selection; realized price -> fees
audit_assumption: Expected recovery flat despite inherited realized+3.7%; catch-up countercase shown
missing_evidence: Forward repair/value costs, near-threshold density, insurer salvage expectations
countercase: Repair inflation or expected recovery rise boosts units
double_count_guard: Do not infer expected-salvage update automatically from reported ASP mix

hypothesis: Pandemic birth cohorts and aging alter claims and selected vehicle economics
evidence_status: Observed birth/production inputs; survival/exposure/old-age split proxies
mechanism: Births x survival x claim propensity -> CCC-anchored cohort mass -> selection
population: Calendar/model-year transfer proxy; not direct insured-policy exposure
audit_assumption: Existing roll versus frozen same-quarter mass; already in saved reference
outputs: cohort claims, TLF, units, ASP and RPU
missing_evidence: Matched insured fleet by age/body; fine 7+ age values; future births/survival
countercase: Older cars have higher total-loss propensity; fleet can grow
double_count_guard: No blanket age coverage haircut in addition to bundled claim propensity

hypothesis: Cheaper replacement parts affect repair decisions and donor bidding
mechanism: Physical basket costs -> repair; donor/rebuilder/scarcity closure -> expected/realized salvage -> same selection and fees
population: Hypothetical fungible eligible basket across US insurance claims
outputs: aftermarket_feedback, units, RPU and service contribution
missing_evidence: Matched component OEM/AM/recycled substitutions, eligible bills and auction bid transmission
countercase: Rebuilder benefit, additional repairs and scarcity offset recycler weakness
double_count_guard: No spending-share-to-quantity shortcut; no separate replay of historical adoption

hypothesis: Tariffs may suppress price-driven aftermarket adoption
evidence_status: Tariff scope observed; pass-through/adoption response assumed
mechanism: Duty -> delivered relative price -> source quantity share -> aftermarket bridge
population: Qualifying HTS/country exposures; no national weighted tariff measured
audit_assumption: No repeal or extra adoption assumed in integrated case
missing_evidence: Import/component weights, pass-through, causal adoption response and policy date
countercase: Inventory/margin absorption or competing price declines offset tariff effect
double_count_guard: Do not add tariff haircut to an already specified delivered-price/adoption ramp

hypothesis: Lost carrier business need not return when the premium cycle improves
evidence_status: Contract contestability observed; carrier mix/allocation paths proxies/assumptions
mechanism: Sum carrier/cohort total losses x routing x Copart allocation
population: Claim/total-loss weights needed; historical auto premium-share proxy remains
audit_assumption: Inherited PGR5% endpoint; Q4 non-PGR allocations and carrier weights held
missing_evidence: Dated allocation volumes by carrier/location and exposure/claim denominator
countercase: Recovered business or new wins offset losses; known losses may already be priced
double_count_guard: No second aggregate share haircut or listed-inventory share as sale flow

hypothesis: Retained/won business may carry different fees and vehicle economics
mechanism: Carrier-specific fee/value/repair terms before selection and revenue aggregation
population: Copart retained/won volume, not competitor concessions on lost volume
audit_assumption: No new concessions in combined case; 25bp PGR sensitivity only
outputs: seller_RPU, buyer_RPU, core_RPU and historical ledger
missing_evidence: Contracts, fees, inclusions, age/body/geography, award dates
countercase: Better terms, mix or ancillary services offset price pressure
double_count_guard: Do not translate IAA incentives directly into a global Copart fee cut
